study_identification_part.si_4_title: Fractionating autism based on neuroanatomical normative modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) sample across six sites; includes neurotypical and autism participants.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We included 206 neurotypical (NT) ... and 316 participants with autism ... across 6 sites from the EU-AIMS LEAP sample"

answer.LEAP: NT cohort used to train normative model; autism cohort used to compute deviations and clustering

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: GPR normative model trained on NT participants (N=206); NPMs computed for autism participants (N=316) for clustering and analyses.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "GPR was trained on the NT cohort (N=206) ... We then created/calculated NPMs for participants with autism, which quantify the deviation of regional CT from the expected neurotypical pattern (N=316)."

model-1.train-phase: NR (10-fold cross-validation; per-fold train size not reported)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Single normative model trained on NT cohort; only total NT N reported.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "GPR was trained on the NT cohort (N=206) ... We used 10-fold cross-validation during the training process"

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: NT cohort age reported as mean ± SD; no split for training folds.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Female N reported for NT cohort; male N inferred from total N=206.
